# f5xc_crl (Resource)

Certificate Revocation List(CRL)<br><br>It contains information about CRL server and how to download the CRL file<br>CRL file is used to validate the certificate presented to check whether it is revoked or not.<br>Clients offerring revoked certificate will not be allowed to access the HTTP Loadbalancer.<br>CRL file is downloaded/refreshed based on the refresh interval.

To get more information about f5xc_crl, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/crl)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Crl - Basic

resource "f5xc_crl" "example" {
  name           = "example-crl-4g2j00ut"
  namespace      = "default"
  server_address = "mycrl.example.com"
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Crl - Full

resource "f5xc_crl" "example" {
  name             = "example-crl-f2iat7n5"
  namespace        = "default"
  description      = "CRL example"
  server_address   = "mycrl.example.com"
  server_port      = 80
  refresh_interval = 24
  timeout          = 10

  labels = {
    env  = "example"
    tier = "shared"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform"
    team  = "security"
  }

  access_info_choice = {
    http_access = {
      path = "/repo/latest.crl"
    }
  }
}
```
